name: emr-extension
description: Interactive demo: an extensible clinical environment – reactive, governed clinical plugins on top of a resilient EMR.

scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.test:api: cd backend && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check .
scripts.serve: npm run build && cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
